author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before had no spray horn: a lever bar sat over a boxy valve, and the hose was a bare hook ending mid-air, so it read as a jar or lantern. Now a domed cylinder with a valve neck, a flared spray horn to the right, and a hose bending left and down to a nozzle tip, as in the reference.
omissions: Bell-shaped hose nozzle (its closed hole is too small at 48; drawn as a T tip).
